column1: ## Repository Table R10. GENCODE representation separation

## Description: Seed-level projected separation and the corresponding within-model projection summary. All metrics are computed on two-dimensional coordinates. The three projection seeds are not independent biological samples.
## Missing values: NA means unavailable or not applicable, never a zero score. Numeric values retain source precision.
## Column 1 | Model | Evaluated checkpoint display name, harmonized with the figures.
## Column 2 | Projection | Projection for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 3 | Seed | Random seed of the recorded projection or sampling run.
## Column 4 | Sequences | Sequences for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 5 | Classes | Classes for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 6 | CH index | Calinski–Harabasz between-class versus within-class dispersion ratio; larger indicates greater separation, without a direction of allelic preference.
## Column 7 | Silhouette | Silhouette coefficient computed in the specified coordinate space.
## Column 8 | Mean CH index | Mean CH index for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 9 | CH SD | CH SD for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 10 | Mean silhouette | Mean silhouette for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 11 | Silhouette SD | Silhouette SD for the observation defined in the table description.
